level_1: Gathers information following a template
level_2: Adapts the template to filter and prioritize pertinent positives and negatives or missing data
level_3: Gathers and synthesizes the history for uncomplicated or typical presentations
level_4: Gathers and synthesizes the history, including protected family health information, for complicated or atypical presentations
level_5: Synthesizes and reappraises the history, incorporating subtle clues for potentially rare presentations

level_1: Performs a physical examination based on a template
level_2: Performs a complete physical examination and identifies variants and abnormal findings
level_3: Adapts the physical examination based on gestational age, patient status, and clinical acuity, and interprets findings to build a differential diagnosis
level_4: Synthesizes and reappraises information gathered via the physical examination to narrow the differential diagnoses
level_5: Detects and integrates subtle physical examination findings to distinguish nuances among competing diagnoses

subcompetencies.name: Organization and Prioritization of Patient Care

level_1: Organizes patient care for an individual patient
level_2: Organizes patient care responsibilities for multiple patients
level_3: Prioritizes and delegates the simultaneous care of patients; triages urgent and emergent issues
level_4: Efficiently prioritizes and delegates patient care responsibilities, maintains situational awareness, and anticipates urgent and emergent issues
level_5: Serves as a role model and coach for balancing patient care responsibilities and unit needs

level_1: Uses pattern recognition to formulate a broad differential diagnosis
level_2: Develops illness scripts and formulates a holistic patient assessment
level_3: Refines illness scripts, while using strategies to identify cognitive bias
level_4: Reappraises illness scripts in real time while using strategies to minimize cognitive bias
level_5: Serves as a role model in clinical reasoning and strategies to minimize cognitive bias

level_1: Develops and implements care plans for patients with a low level of acuity/complexity
level_2: Develops and implements care plans for patients with a high level of acuity/complexity
level_3: Coordinates and implements multidisciplinary care plans for patients with a high level of acuity/complexity
level_4: Manages patients with multiple levels of acuity/complexity while anticipating future needs and minimizing long-term consequences
level_5: Role models and coaches others in the management of patients requiring complex multidisciplinary care, while anticipating future needs and minimizing long-term complications

level_1: Performs simple procedures with assistance

Adapts technique based on patient acuity and anatomy
level_3: Performs complex procedures with assistance
Anticipates, recognizes, and manages uncommon complications

level_1: Identifies unstable patients and performs basic interventions

subcompetencies.name: Discharge from the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit

level_4: Partners with the patient’s family in discharge planning and provides education for a patient with high- complexity needs, while anticipating and coordinating multidisciplinary follow- up care
level_5: Role models partnering with patients’ families in discharging and providing education for patients with high-complexity needs

level_1: Demonstrates basic knowledge of normal maternal-fetal and neonatal physiology
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of maternal-fetal and neonatal pathophysiology
level_3: Applies knowledge of pathophysiology of common and typical conditions to guide patient care

level_5: Role models diagnostic evaluation that achieves high-value care

subcompetencies.name: System Navigation for Patient-Centered Care – Coordination of Care

level_1: Lists the various interprofessional individuals involved in the patient’s care coordination

level_3: Coordinates care of patients in complex clinical situations, effectively utilizing the roles of interprofessional teams, and incorporating patient and family needs and goals

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems
